description: Ministry of Power & Renewable Energy - Order made to approve the Proposed acquisition of the Land in Nugepola, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District, required by the Ceylon Electricity Board
categorisation: The gazette content is an order under the Ceylon Electricity Board Act approving the acquisition of a specific parcel of land (1.4508 Hectares) in the village of Nugepola, with a detailed description of its boundaries and location. This falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes), which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters. While a government minister is named, the core subject is the land acquisition, not the minister's portfolio responsibilities or a government personnel change.
